overall_comparison: Document A (Apex NDA) is a reciprocal mutual confidentiality agreement with equal obligations. Document B (Zenith Employment) is a unilateral employment agreement containing restrictive non-compete and intellectual property transfer clauses. Document A is significantly more balanced and favorable for mutual business evaluation.

differences.doc_a_provision: Mutual bilateral confidentiality protecting both Apex and Horizon equally.
differences.doc_b_provision: Unilateral IP assignment and post-employment non-compete binding the individual.
differences.analysis: Document A offers mutual reciprocity, whereas Document B restricts the individual's future competitive freedom.

differences.doc_a_provision: 5-year confidentiality period with perpetual protection for trade secrets.
differences.analysis: While Document A has a longer confidentiality duration, Document B imposes direct career livelihood restrictions.

differences.doc_a_provision: Binding arbitration in San Francisco, California under AAA Commercial Rules.
differences.doc_b_provision: Governed by New York law without specified mandatory arbitration.
